biography.plain_text: Giovanni Francesco Capua, known as Gianfranco, is an Italian industrialist and fourth-generation president of Capua 1880, his family's Calabrian citrus-essence producer. After succeeding his father, he modernised extraction and processing, expanded the company's international reach and developed specialised bergamot products for fragrance, cosmetics and food clients. His sons now share its leadership.

long_biography.plain_text:
Capua 1880's roots in bergamot predate Giovanni Francesco Capua by three generations, but its present technical profile bears his imprint. Trained in economics and economic statistics, he entered the business through commercial work and later took responsibility for its management.

Known as Gianfranco, Capua combined export expansion with process engineering. He helped develop methods for removing phototoxic compounds from bergamot oil and for cold-extracting volatile elements from citrus juice, producing concentrated aromatic extracts for global fragrance and flavour markets. The company added modern processing, research and quality-control systems while maintaining its Calabrian supply base. Italy recognised that industrial contribution by appointing him a Cavaliere del Lavoro in 2019.
